title: Blue Marble: Clouds
credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center, image by Reto Stöckli
composition: Two days of visible imagery plus a third day of polar thermal-infrared imagery; not a single instantaneous observation.
preparation: Full global field converted to a scalar grayscale texture, Lanczos downsampled to 4096x2048 and encoded as progressive JPEG quality 95. No cloud shapes painted, synthesized, sharpened or rearranged in the bitmap.
runtime: Longitude wraps, latitude clamps. Accelerated coherent transport and bounded deformation; broad era moisture modulates opacity. Illustrative weather, not a paleo-weather reconstruction or forecast.
